packageRules.description: vue-tsc (nuxt typecheck) loads typescript/lib/tsc, which TypeScript 7 no longer exports; AGENTS.md pins 5.x until vue-tsc supports newer releases

A Go major version is a new import path: bumping go.mod alone leaves the code on the old version and can break the build (#82, #83, #85, #86). Wait for approval on the dependency dashboard and migrate the imports in the same change.
